title: 重击对轻群体反制｜诱饵让位、群体绕行与武器缠束
source_title: 纸鹤封刀｜重剑浪人与折纸阴阳师反制
summary: 先建立明确成年重型攻击者和轻量群体控制者；重击完整承诺后，轻群体避让并从攻击轨迹背后重组，逐步把进攻武器和身体缠束，最终由被反制姿态证明战术翻转。
input_format: Establish two clearly adult original opponents, one heavy attack system and one light swarm system. + Require the heavy attack to commit a readable path before the swarm changes formation. + Make the swarm evade, preserve units and regroup behind the attack path to bind one functional point. + Escalate binding through the attacker's repeated force while keeping both adult identities and geography readable. + End on a stable immobilization proof with the controller unharmed and the attacker's original weapon still identifiable.
recommended_input: 原创雪地无线电场内，明确成年魁梧打捞工持红色磁力锤，面对穿白色工作外套的明确成年无人机管理员；一群薄黑检查无人机围绕她。；锤子掠过后，同一批无人机从后方绕回，连接成柔性黑带，只缠住锤头和手腕，两名成年人都保持可读。；同一批带状无人机让打捞工直立受控；成年管理员安然站在原场地标记处并放下手，不加文字，不复制来源服装和武器。
required_anchors: Establish two clearly adult original opponents, one heavy attack system and one light swarm system.
Require the heavy attack to commit a readable path before the swarm changes formation.
Escalate binding through the attacker's repeated force while keeping both adult identities and geography readable.
End on a stable immobilization proof with the controller unharmed and the attacker's original weapon still identifiable.
